protocol: Transfer the published four-shot recipes to three additional visually inspected synthetic adults. Keep each shot's seed and settings fixed; change only the source, pronouns and visible appearance description. Always edit the original source, never a previous output. Visual review is qualitative. This small convenience sample is not a population benchmark.

runtime: Hosted Diffusers Krea2Pipeline, krea/Krea-2-Turbo with identity-edit v1.2 fused at 1.0. Exact loaded model weight hashes were not exposed; this is not ComfyUI inference.
billing: Free public quota only. No paid account, API credit, subscription or quota workaround.
postprocessing: None. Original provider-returned WebP bytes are preserved. Browser PNG transport encodes the reference at its original size without crop, resizing or retouching.

pack.identity: Preserve his distinctive face, blue-green eyes, natural skin texture, short receding brown hair, short salt-and-pepper beard and plain black crew-neck shirt.

shots.title: Front-facing portrait
shots.direction: Rotate the head and shoulders of this same adult man into a perfectly straight-on front view. Symmetrical passport portrait, looking directly into the lens, both ears visible. Do not keep the reference camera angle.
shots.acceptance: Face square to camera and direct eye contact; recognizable facial features and hair; no obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

shots.title: Side-profile portrait
shots.direction: Photograph this same adult man in a strict 90-degree side profile facing the left edge of the image. Only one eye and one side of his face are visible; his nose is in profile.
shots.acceptance: Clear side profile with one visible eye; coherent nose, ear and jaw; recognizable hair, face and shirt.

shots.title: Full-body studio shot
shots.direction: Photograph this same adult man standing upright, shown from the top of his head to the soles of both shoes with generous space above and below. His arms rest naturally at his sides. Add straight dark trousers and simple black flat shoes.
shots.framing: Full-length studio photograph, camera at waist height,
shots.acceptance: Head, hands and both shoes fully in frame; plausible anatomy, clothing and floor contact; recognizable subject. New trousers and shoes are invented, not recovered from the reference.

shots.title: Beauty close-up
shots.direction: Create a tight beauty close-up photograph of this same adult man. His face fills the frame from the forehead to just below the chin, with the eyes in sharp focus, a relaxed closed mouth and a subtle three-quarter turn.
shots.framing: Natural editorial beauty photograph, visible skin pores, no beauty retouching,
shots.acceptance: Clearly tighter framing than the source; coherent eyes, mouth and skin texture; recognizable features without obvious smoothing artifacts.
